feature: Dragging a zoomed-in recording keys where it is centred
summary: With a zoom keyed on a recording, dragging the picture now frames the zoom: it writes Position keys at the zoom's keys, so the wide shot before the zoom stays exactly where it was instead of sliding off and showing the canvas.
setup: Photonz Probe built from main, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: framing-a-zoom-keys-its-centre-walk.

try.do: Open a screen recording, click it on the canvas, and click 0:03 on the ruler.
Animate a property > Scale, so Scale has a key at 0:03 holding 100%.
Click 0:05 on the ruler and type 220 into Scale.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: With the Select tool, drag the picture until the Copying card fills the frame.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click 0:03 on the ruler: the wide shot is where it was, Position reads 0, 0.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Command Z once: both Position keys and the drag go, the two Scale keys stay.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Play from 0:02: the picture pushes in and pans onto the card together.

evaluate: Does dragging the zoomed picture feel like pointing the camera, with nothing before the zoom moving?
Dragging at the wide key (0:03) instead moves the wide shot and leaves the zoom alone. Is that what you expect?
With only one Scale key (nothing zooming yet) a drag still just moves the clip. Is that the right line?
Should the same rule apply to titles and pictures with a keyed size, or stay recordings only (today it is recordings only, the way Premiere moves a title)?
rough: The new lane is named Position and sits above the Scale lane, and its row shows the clip's corner (X 740, Y 280); the walkthrough draws a Centre lane under Scale showing the point in the middle of the frame. Covered by task a-recording-s-framing-reads-as-scale-then-centre.

A drag after the last Scale key (say at 0:08) pans from 0:05 to 0:08 rather than moving the whole held zoom; it keeps the wide shot still, but someone wanting to reframe the whole hold drags at 0:05 instead.
